mika.name: Mika Tanabe
mika.title: The Street Striker
mika.tagline: Fast hands, long combos, never lets up.
mika.bio: Striker of the Depot's factory-league team, who drives a dock crane by night. Mika fights the way she plays: always moving, chaining quick punches into long combos that build speed as they land, and finishing before trouble can answer. Each punch is light; the flow is what hurts.

oren.name: Oren Vale
oren.title: The Grappler
oren.tagline: Get a hand on them and it is over.
oren.bio: A former harbour wrestler who hauls freight for the Depot crew. Oren takes more punishment than anyone and fights at arm's length: he seizes a foe, slams them into the street or throws them into their friends. He has to get close first, and a missed grab leaves him open.

riku.name: Riku Sato
riku.title: The Boxer
riku.tagline: One clean punch is worth ten wild ones.
riku.bio: A night-shift courier who trained in a boxing gym above Saltmarket Street. Riku picks his moment and lands the punch that matters: heavy crosses, body blows and a counter for whoever swings first. Nobody hits one target harder; a crowd is harder work.

kan.name: Kan Srisuk
kan.title: The Brawler
kan.tagline: Owns the court, owns the crowd.
kan.bio: Point guard of the night league on the market's back court, who delivers for the noodle shops by day. Kan reads a crowd like a defence and breaks it: wide swings, ground-shaking blows and a rush that ploughs through a line. He hits many at once, and less on any one of them.

dao.name: Dao Kittikun
dao.title: The Counter Fighter
dao.tagline: Read it, block it, turn it around.
dao.bio: A sergeant suspended for chasing a case she was told to drop. Dao waits, guards and answers: her skills catch an attack and turn it back harder. She parries from further out than anyone, but waiting alone never wins a fight.
